messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: doc revisions in: feature/issue-211-stan2-manual
parts:
I pushed all the doc revisions I had. There were a ton
of fixes.

I added a new chapter at the start of the programming
chapter on general programming techniques.

I added a lot of explanation and also command skeletons
and more examples in the command-line Stan chapter. But
most of that's still text from Michael.

I added the sampling syntax to all the distributions and
also indexed it.

- Bob

parts:
I pushed my changes -- mostly respecting the new organization (deviating only to clean up all the dangling subsections). The optimization template text is a bit choppy, but I was too tired to fix it.

The full argument hierarchy was originally meant to just be a formatted version of the help-all output so that the doc could be quickly updated whenever the args were tweaked. We'll just have to be careful to keep them up to date now.
